description: This file defines an Android Activity class 'PathAnimations' that demonstrates path-based animations of a view. It includes setup of paths, animation controls, and a custom inner view for drawing paths.

classes.name: PathAnimations
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating path-based animations, handling user input, and controlling the animation of a view along a path.

classes.name: PathAnimations.CanvasView
classes.description: Custom view used to draw the animation path.

classes.name: PathAnimations.PointFToPointConverter
classes.description: TypeConverter subclass transforming PointF to Point for animation purposes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, and path.

methods.name: setCoordinates
methods.description: Updates position of animated view using integer coordinates.

methods.name: changeCoordinates
methods.description: Updates position of animated view with float coordinates.

methods.name: setPoint
methods.description: Updates position using a PointF object.

methods.name: onCheckedChanged
methods.description: Handles radio button selection changes to restart animation accordingly.

methods.name: startAnimator
methods.description: Creates and begins the path animation based on selected type.
